title: El legado neoliberal
goal: Read a closing, balanced assessment of the neoliberal decade -- the inflation-taming success of the reforms, against the structural fragility exposed by Mexico's 1994 Tequila Effect and the 2001 collapse of Argentina's convertibility.

items: State the achievement defenders of the model point to.
Explain how the reforms rescued the region from an inflationary spiral.
Explain what the Tequila Effect and the 2001 collapse exposed about the model.
Summarize the "paradox" many analysts see in the neoliberal legacy.
